title: ReCreate: Reasoning and Creating Domain Agents Driven by Experience
abstract: arXiv:2601.11100v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are reshaping the industrial landscape. However, most practical agents still rely on human-designed scaffolds, making their creation and adaptation across diverse domains labor-intensive. This situation poses a central question: can we automatically create and evolve domain agents through interaction experience in real-world environments? While recent approaches have sought to automate agent creation, several treat scaffold optimization as a black-box procedure guided primarily by final performance metrics. Such strategies overlook critical evidence explaining why an agent succeeds or fails and often incur high computational costs. To address these limitations, we propose ReCreate, an experience-driven framework for creating and evolving specialized domain agents. ReCreate systematically leverages agent interaction histories to identify the causes of success and failure and guide targeted scaffold up

translated_title: ReCreate：由经验驱动的领域智能体推理与创建
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正在重塑产业格局。然而，大多数实用智能体仍依赖人工设计的脚手架，使得跨领域创建和适配这些智能体变得十分耗费人力。由此引出一个核心问题：我们能否通过真实环境中的交互经验自动创建并演化领域智能体？尽管近期一些方法已致力于智能体创建的自动化，但其中若干方法将脚手架优化视为一个主要由最终性能指标引导的黑盒过程。这类策略忽略了能够解释智能体为何成功或失败的关键证据，且往往带来高昂的计算成本。为解决这些局限，我们提出ReCreate——一个经验驱动的框架，用于创建和演化专门的领域智能体。ReCreate系统性地利用智能体的交互历史来识别成功与失败的原因，并据此指导有针对性的脚手架更新……
tldr: ReCreate是一个经验驱动的框架，通过系统分析智能体交互历史中的成功与失败原因来指导脚手架的针对性更新，从而自动创建并演化领域专用智能体，克服了黑盒优化方法可解释性差、计算成本高的问题。
